hypothesis: The energy density of a lithium-ion battery using LiCoO2 and graphite electrodes will be higher than that of a lithium metal battery due to the elimination of dendrite formation while maintaining lithium ion intercalation capability.
prediction: The specific energy density of a LiCoO2-graphite lithium-ion battery will be 150 Wh/kg
measurement_method: Measure the total energy stored (Wh) per unit mass (kg) of the fully assembled battery under standard discharge conditions
falsification_condition: Observed specific energy density < 105 Wh/kg or > 195 Wh/kg
